title: Improving performance in the layers panel
summary: Speeds up a layers panel that rebuilt all expanded rows on any change via windowed data and cached derived properties.

title: PGKeeper: Building the bouncer we needed for Postgres
summary: Replaces PgBouncer, which could not prioritize traffic or limit connection churn, with the Go gRPC pooler PGKeeper.

title: Figma's next-generation data caching platform
summary: Stops thundering herds of Redis connections on client scale-ups by pooling them in FigCache, a stateless RESP proxy.

title: Figma rendering: Powered by WebGPU
summary: Prevents per-uniform buffer uploads from slowing a WebGPU port by reworking the graphics API to batch them per submit.

title: Supporting faster file load times with memory optimizations in Rust
summary: Shrinks node property maps, the bulk of a file's memory on the server, by swapping BTreeMap for a flat sorted Vec.

title: The infrastructure behind AI search in Figma
summary: Lowers the cost of indexing every frame for CLIP search, mostly thumbnailing, with C++ and llvmpipe CPU rendering.

title: The search for speed in Figma
summary: Traces slow search hidden by a per-shard OpenSearch metric to permission checks, then trims the index and shard count.

title: Speeding up file load times, one page at a time
summary: Spares editors slow full-file loads by loading one page plus its read and write dependencies from QueryGraph.

title: Keeping it 100(x) with real-time data at scale
summary: Ends LiveGraph's fan-out of all database updates to all servers with an invalidation cache and stateless invalidators.

title: Speeding up C++ build times
summary: Ties build times outpacing code growth to unneeded includes bloating preprocessed bytes, then flags them with DIWYDU.

title: How Figma's databases team lived to tell the scale
summary: Shards tables too big for one RDS Postgres behind DBProxy, rolling shards out as views before any physical split.

title: Improving performance with incremental frame loading
summary: Fixes slow loads and mobile crashes in large prototypes by subscribing to only the current and adjacent screens.

title: The growing pains of database architecture
summary: Moves table groups off a CPU-strained RDS Postgres via logical replication, cutting over with a PgBouncer pause.

title: Making multiplayer more reliable
summary: Stops crashes from losing edits made since the last S3 checkpoint by journaling sequenced changes to DynamoDB.

title: Postmortem: Service disruptions on June 6 & 7 2022
summary: Traces pegged Redis CPU to pub/sub memmoves on a growing Cluster Bus buffer, then moves pub/sub off cluster mode.

title: GraphQL, meet LiveGraph: a real-time data system at scale
summary: Replaces ad hoc update events, which caused consistency bugs, with LiveGraph routing Postgres WAL rows to subqueries.

title: Behind the feature: The hidden challenges of autosave
summary: Preserves offline edits across tab closes by storing per-node changes in IndexedDB, as full-file saves stall the UI.

title: How Figma's multiplayer technology works
summary: Skips OT's complexity and CRDT overhead with per-property last-writer-wins values ordered by a central server.

title: An alternative approach to rate limiting
summary: Avoids token bucket races, fixed-window bursts and sliding-log memory by summing short-window counters in a Redis hash.

title: Realtime editing of ordered sequences
summary: Sidesteps OT's complexity for concurrent reordering by sorting children on fractional indices, so moves edit one value.
